replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
It's sad to see you go, but you can't give your diamond rank away.
It's only possible to transfer ranks to an alternate account that only you own.
Next time look at the Avicus Shop FAQ:

Can I transfer my rank to a different account?

 Ranks purchased are strictly not transferrable, unless you are switching to a new Minecraft account. You may not move your rank from one Minecraft account to another unless you own both accounts.

Bye and good luck in your future endeavors!
